faq.a: Fehim is associated with the Arabic form فَهِيم, whose core sense is fehim; understanding, intelligent.

faq.q: What is the origin of Fehim?
faq.a: Fehim is associated with Arabic. Fehim is the Bosnian form of Arabic فَهِيم (Fahīm), meaning 'understanding, intelligent'.
Yes — the underlying form فَهِيم is Arabic.
Fehim can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Fehim should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Fahīm is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Fehim, fehim. Script forms are فهيم, فهیم, فَهِيم, فہیم, फ़हीम.
